# One shared gateway for agents to read and write work

This feature gives every AI assistant you use the same door into your tasks and records. Whichever tool your team works with, they all see and update the same information, so nothing gets out of sync.

## Contents

- [What it does for you](#what-it-does-for-you)
- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Good to know](#good-to-know)
- [Words used here](#words-used-here)

## What it does for you

- Keeps one shared source of truth, so different AI assistants are never working from different pictures of the work
- Lets an assistant pick up a task exactly where it was left, including what still needs attention
- Lets you choose how much an assistant can do, from just looking things up to fully managing tasks and documents
- Keeps each change to a task or record on record, so you can see what changed and when
- Keeps what the assistant sees lean, so it only loads the detail it actually needs

## How it works

1. You, or your team, use an AI assistant connected to this shared gateway.
2. The assistant asks the gateway what is still unfinished, picking up from where things were left.
3. The assistant reads or updates tasks and records through the gateway, never on its own.
4. Every update is saved as a new version, so the history is kept.
5. If the assistant asks for something it is not allowed to do, it is told so, and it can try again correctly.

## Good to know

- What an assistant is allowed to do depends on the level of access it has been given, from basic read-only up to full control.
- Different assistants can be connected to the same gateway at once, all working from the same information.
- Large pieces of information are only loaded in full when actually needed, to keep things fast.

## Words used here

- agent: an AI assistant that can read and act on your tasks on your behalf.
- task: a piece of work being tracked, made up of records.
- record: one entry in a task, such as a question, an answer, a decision, or a note.
- repo: the project folder the work belongs to.
